title: AWS CloudWatch Overview
description: EC2, RDS, ALB, Lambda and SQS health from a CloudWatch metric stream (JSON output format) sent to the cloudwatch_metrics logs stream.

panels.title: Minutes since last datapoint
panels.description: Minutes since OpenObserve last received a row in cloudwatch_metrics within the selected time range. A metric stream stops quietly when Firehose delivery fails; this number then keeps growing, and the panel shows no value once no row arrived in the whole range.

queries.query: SELECT (to_unixtime(now()) - max(_timestamp) / 1000000) / 60.0 AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region)

panels.title: Datapoints received by namespace
panels.description: Rows received per AWS namespace, by arrival time. Each row is one 1-minute statistic set for one metric and one dimension combination.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, namespace AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: EC2 CPU utilization by instance (avg %)
panels.description: Average CPU per instance: sum of sums divided by sum of sample counts. Only rows with an InstanceId are read, so Auto Scaling group, image and instance type rows are not counted.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, dimensions_instanceid AS breakdown_1, sum(value_sum) / sum(value_count) AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/EC2' AND metric_name = 'CPUUtilization' AND dimensions_instanceid IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_instanceid IN ($instance_id) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: EC2 instances failing status checks
panels.description: Instances with any failed status check in the time range. An empty table means every instance passed.

queries.query: SELECT dimensions_instanceid AS instance, account_id, region, metric_name, max(value_max) AS worst, count(*) AS failing_minutes, to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)) AS last_seen FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/EC2' AND metric_name IN ('StatusCheckFailed', 'StatusCheckFailed_Instance', 'StatusCheckFailed_System', 'StatusCheckFailed_AttachedEBS') AND dimensions_instanceid IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_instanceid IN ($instance_id) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) AND value_max >= 1 GROUP BY instance, account_id, region, metric_name ORDER BY last_seen DESC

panels.title: EC2 network in and out (bytes per minute)
panels.description: Bytes per minute summed over the selected instances: each point is the bytes of all 1-minute datapoints in the chart interval divided by the number of datapoint minutes in it. Per-instance rows only.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, metric_name AS breakdown_1, sum(value_sum) / count(DISTINCT timestamp) AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/EC2' AND metric_name IN ('NetworkIn', 'NetworkOut') AND dimensions_instanceid IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_instanceid IN ($instance_id) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: RDS CPU utilization by DB instance (avg %)
panels.description: Average CPU per DB instance. Only rows with a DBInstanceIdentifier are read, so cluster, class and engine rows are not counted.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier AS breakdown_1, sum(value_sum) / sum(value_count) AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/RDS' AND metric_name = 'CPUUtilization' AND dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier IN ($db_instance) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Lowest free storage by DB instance (GiB)
panels.description: The smallest FreeStorageSpace seen in the time range, lowest first.

queries.query: SELECT dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier AS x_axis_1, min(value_min) / 1073741824 AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/RDS' AND metric_name = 'FreeStorageSpace' AND dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier IN ($db_instance) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 ASC LIMIT 20

panels.title: RDS database connections (max)
panels.description: Highest connection count per interval per DB instance.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier AS breakdown_1, max(value_max) AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/RDS' AND metric_name = 'DatabaseConnections' AND dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier IN ($db_instance) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: RDS read latency (avg, seconds)
panels.description: Average read I/O latency per DB instance.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier AS breakdown_1, sum(value_sum) / sum(value_count) AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/RDS' AND metric_name = 'ReadLatency' AND dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier IN ($db_instance) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: RDS write latency (avg, seconds)
panels.description: Average write I/O latency per DB instance.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier AS breakdown_1, sum(value_sum) / sum(value_count) AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/RDS' AND metric_name = 'WriteLatency' AND dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_dbinstanceidentifier IN ($db_instance) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: ALB requests and 5xx by load balancer
panels.description: Requests, load balancer 5xx and target 5xx per interval, per load balancer. Per zone and per target group rows are folded into the load balancer total, not added to it.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, res || ' ' || metric_name AS breakdown_1, sum(s) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT dimensions_loadbalancer AS res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp, max(value_sum) AS s, max(value_count) AS c, max(_timestamp) AS _timestamp FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/ApplicationELB' AND metric_name IN ('RequestCount', 'HTTPCode_ELB_5XX_Count', 'HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count') AND dimensions_loadbalancer IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_loadbalancer IN ($load_balancer) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp) AS t GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: ALB target response time (avg, seconds)
panels.description: Average time targets take to respond, per load balancer.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, res AS breakdown_1, sum(s) / sum(c) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT dimensions_loadbalancer AS res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp, max(value_sum) AS s, max(value_count) AS c, max(_timestamp) AS _timestamp FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/ApplicationELB' AND metric_name = 'TargetResponseTime' AND dimensions_loadbalancer IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_loadbalancer IN ($load_balancer) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp) AS t GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: ALB target response time (max, seconds)
panels.description: Slowest target response per interval, per load balancer.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, dimensions_loadbalancer AS breakdown_1, max(value_max) AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/ApplicationELB' AND metric_name = 'TargetResponseTime' AND dimensions_loadbalancer IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_loadbalancer IN ($load_balancer) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Target groups with unhealthy or no healthy hosts
panels.description: Target groups that had an unhealthy host, or no healthy host, in the time range. Per zone rows are folded into the target group total. An empty table means all target groups were healthy. Needs per target group metrics (the dimensions_targetgroup column).

queries.query: SELECT target_group, res AS load_balancer, account_id, region, max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'UnHealthyHostCount' THEN mx END) AS max_unhealthy, min(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'HealthyHostCount' THEN mn END) AS min_healthy FROM (SELECT dimensions_loadbalancer AS res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp, dimensions_targetgroup AS target_group, max(value_max) AS mx, max(value_min) AS mn, max(_timestamp) AS _timestamp FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/ApplicationELB' AND metric_name IN ('UnHealthyHostCount', 'HealthyHostCount') AND dimensions_loadbalancer IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_targetgroup IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_loadbalancer IN ($load_balancer) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY res, target_group, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp) AS t GROUP BY target_group, load_balancer, account_id, region HAVING max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'UnHealthyHostCount' THEN mx END) > 0 OR min(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'HealthyHostCount' THEN mn END) = 0 ORDER BY min_healthy ASC

panels.title: Lambda invocations, errors and throttles by function
panels.description: Counts per interval per function. Per alias and per version rows are folded into the function total, not added to it.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, res || ' ' || metric_name AS breakdown_1, sum(s) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT dimensions_functionname AS res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp, max(value_sum) AS s, max(value_count) AS c, max(_timestamp) AS _timestamp FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/Lambda' AND metric_name IN ('Invocations', 'Errors', 'Throttles') AND dimensions_functionname IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_functionname IN ($function_name) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp) AS t GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, res AS breakdown_1, sum(s) / sum(c) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT dimensions_functionname AS res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp, max(value_sum) AS s, max(value_count) AS c, max(_timestamp) AS _timestamp FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/Lambda' AND metric_name = 'Duration' AND dimensions_functionname IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_functionname IN ($function_name) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp) AS t GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Lambda duration (max, ms)
panels.description: Longest run per interval per function.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, dimensions_functionname AS breakdown_1, max(value_max) AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/Lambda' AND metric_name = 'Duration' AND dimensions_functionname IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_functionname IN ($function_name) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: SQS age of oldest message (seconds)
panels.description: How long the oldest message has waited, per queue. A rising line means consumers are stuck or too slow.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, dimensions_queuename AS breakdown_1, max(value_max) AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/SQS' AND metric_name = 'ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage' AND dimensions_queuename IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_queuename IN ($queue_name) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: SQS visible messages
panels.description: Messages waiting to be received, per queue.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, dimensions_queuename AS breakdown_1, max(value_max) AS y_axis_1 FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/SQS' AND metric_name = 'ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible' AND dimensions_queuename IS NOT NULL AND dimensions_queuename IN ($queue_name) AND account_id IN ($account) AND region IN ($region) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
